name: horizontal-strip-reel
title: Horizontal Strip Reel
description: Horizontal snap-scrolling card strip with peek margins and smooth momentum scrolling.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Rail
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: None
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Horizontal Momentum Scroll: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
